parameters.query:
select public.promote_contact_to_lead(
         $1::uuid, $2::uuid, nullif($3, '')::uuid,
         jsonb_strip_nulls(jsonb_build_object(
           'email',        nullif($4, ''),
           'first_name',   nullif($5, ''),
           'last_name',    nullif($6, ''),
           'job_title',    nullif($7, ''),
           'company_name', nullif($8, ''),
           'website',      nullif($9, ''),
           'phone_number', nullif($10, ''),
           'phone_source', nullif($11, '')
         ))) as result;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [ String($('[45] Set last_reply (LATEST by date_received DESC)').first().json.last_reply.data[0].campaign_id), $('[S] Resolve client sequencer').first().json.client_sequencer_id ] }}

parameters.query:
select c.id::text as campaign_id
from public.campaigns c
join public.client_sequencers cs on cs.client_id = c.client_id and cs.id = $2::uuid
where c.external_id = $1
limit 1;

select cs.id::text as client_sequencer_id, cs.client_id::text as client_id
from public.client_sequencers cs
join public.sequencers s on s.id = cs.sequencer_id and s.key = 'emailbison'
where cs.external_workspace_id = $1 and cs.enabled
limit 1;

options.queryReplacement: ={{ (() => { const r = $('[45] Set last_reply (LATEST by date_received DESC)').first().json.last_reply.data[0]; return [ String(r.id), r.date_received, $json.sequencer_contact_id, r.subject || null, r.text_body || null, r.from_email_address || null ]; })() }}
